namespace DxmLocalProjectImport
{
    using System;
    using System.IO;
    using System.Linq;
    using System.Security.Cryptography;
    using System.Text;
    using UnityEditor;
    using UnityEditor.Compilation;
    using UnityEngine;
    using PackageInfo = UnityEditor.PackageManager.PackageInfo;

    /// <summary>Records actual package registration and compiled package assemblies.</summary>
    public static class Probe
    {
        [Serializable]
        public sealed class PackageRecord
        {
            public string name;
            public string version;
            public string source;
            public string resolvedPath;
        }

        [Serializable]
        public sealed class AssemblyRecord
        {
            public string name;
            public string path;
            public string sha256;
            public string[] sourceFiles;
        }

        [Serializable]
        public sealed class Receipt
        {
            public int schemaVersion = 1;
            public string variant;
            public string sourceCommit;
            public string unityVersion;
            public string packageRoot;
            public string runtimeAssembly;
            public string runtimeAssemblySha256;
            public PackageRecord[] packages;
            public AssemblyRecord[] assemblies;
            public bool completed;
        }

        public static void Run()
        {
            if (
                Application.unityVersion != "2022.3.45f1"
                || !Application.isBatchMode
                || Application.platform != RuntimePlatform.WindowsEditor
                || IntPtr.Size != 8
            )
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Expected the exact batch-mode Editor.");
            if (EditorApplication.isCompiling || EditorApplication.isUpdating)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Import/compilation is still active.");
            string path = Required("DXM_LOCAL_PROJECT_RECEIPT");
            string expectedRoot = NormalizeRoot(Required("DXM_LOCAL_PROJECT_PACKAGE_ROOT"));
            System.Reflection.Assembly runtime =
                typeof(DxMessaging.Core.MessageBus.MessageBus).Assembly;
            PackageInfo own = PackageInfo.FindForAssembly(runtime);
            if (
                own == null
                || own.name != "com.wallstop-studios.dxmessaging"
                || !string.Equals(
                    NormalizeRoot(own.resolvedPath),
                    expectedRoot,
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase
                )
            )
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    "Loaded Runtime is not the owned source package."
                );
            UnityEditor.Compilation.Assembly[] compiled = CompilationPipeline.GetAssemblies(
                AssembliesType.Editor
            );
            string[] required =
            {
                "WallstopStudios.DxMessaging",
                "WallstopStudios.DxMessaging.Editor",
                "WallstopStudios.DxMessaging.Tests.Runtime",
                "WallstopStudios.DxMessaging.Tests.Editor",
            };
            foreach (string name in required)
                if (!compiled.Any(a => a.name == name))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException(
                        "Required package assembly absent: " + name
                    );
            UnityEditor.Compilation.Assembly[] packageAssemblies = compiled
                .Where(a =>
                    a.name.StartsWith("WallstopStudios.DxMessaging", StringComparison.Ordinal)
                )
                .ToArray();
            Receipt result = new Receipt
            {
                variant = Required("DXM_LOCAL_PROJECT_VARIANT"),
                sourceCommit = Required("DXM_LOCAL_PROJECT_SOURCE_HEAD"),
                unityVersion = Application.unityVersion,
                packageRoot = own.resolvedPath,
                runtimeAssembly = runtime.Location,
                runtimeAssemblySha256 = Hash(runtime.Location),
                packages = PackageInfo
                    .GetAllRegisteredPackages()
                    .Select(p => new PackageRecord
                    {
                        name = p.name,
                        version = p.version,
                        source = p.source.ToString(),
                        resolvedPath = p.resolvedPath,
                    })
                    .OrderBy(p => p.name, StringComparer.Ordinal)
                    .ToArray(),
                assemblies = packageAssemblies
                    .Select(a => new AssemblyRecord
                    {
                        name = a.name,
                        path = a.outputPath,
                        sha256 = Hash(a.outputPath),
                        sourceFiles = a.sourceFiles,
                    })
                    .OrderBy(a => a.name, StringComparer.Ordinal)
                    .ToArray(),
                completed = true,
            };
            File.WriteAllText(path, JsonUtility.ToJson(result, true), new UTF8Encoding(false));
            Debug.Log("LOCAL_PROJECT_IMPORT_COMPLETE variant=" + result.variant);
            EditorApplication.Exit(0);
        }

        private static string Required(string name)
        {
            string value = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable(name);
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
                throw new InvalidOperationException(name + " is missing.");
            return value;
        }

        private static string Hash(string path)
        {
            if (!Path.IsPathRooted(path))
                path = Path.Combine(Application.dataPath, "..", path);
            if (!File.Exists(path))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Compiled assembly is absent: " + path);
            using (SHA256 hash = SHA256.Create())
            using (FileStream stream = File.OpenRead(path))
                return BitConverter
                    .ToString(hash.ComputeHash(stream))
                    .Replace("-", "")
                    .ToLowerInvariant();
        }

        private static string NormalizeRoot(string path)
        {
            return Path.GetFullPath(path)
                .TrimEnd(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, Path.AltDirectorySeparatorChar);
        }
    }
}
